shared_elements: human or humanoid head/face with eyes, nose and mouth
frontal or profile depiction of a face
justification: The only shared content is the presence of a face with eyes, nose and mouth: A is an isolated frontal head with heavy brow ridges and no accompanying elements, while B is a full narrative relief of a bird-headed winged figure in profile striding beside stylized palmette-like plants under a band of dense inscription. There is no shared motif, relationship or arrangement, and the manner of depiction differs sharply — A is blocky and schematic in the round, B is a low-relief, detailed profile figure with articulated wings, feathers and musculature.
